actions.name: IMPORT_ROOM_ADDITIONS_REVIEW
actions.source: fixed nenovakakao 수입방 raw archive GET using the existing server credential and original external identity; review sheet provides customer aliases only; latest two actual order dates via latestImportFeed through Seoul today (up to 31 days), with later cancellation review. Only additions and relevant review requests returned; general messages removed. Explicit additions with independently parsed complete rows and unit-missing rows include only the complete rows by default. Raw quantities override empty/incorrect pre-extracted quantity cells. Standalone company plus numeric CL is the customer heading for subsequent lines within the same message. Same sender/time/normalized text dedup, deleted snapshot review; sender field is withheld. Totals segregate year/week/country/category/product/unit; unnamed quantities included. The left ERP country and year/major or exact subcycle limit both Kakao panes. Unscoped metadata is never inferred to match an explicit year/cycle. The newest 100 matching originals render first with more batches; matching contributors remain reachable and all eligible items enter totals. Exact counted rows (item, unit, quantity and known customer) are shown on the original. Totals in center are grouped by country, then product group, then exact year and cycle. Both center totals and right originals display loading, error and empty states; refresh retains previous data, and transmitting via the clipboard is disabled while refreshing or after a failed refresh. chronological plain-text originals on the right show newest first and support room/date/body search and all/add/cancel filters. Matching shows only contributing originals or totals. Cancellation amounts cannot be included in the farm totals. Other review is browser-local and unchecked until verified. Browser edits and clipboard only; no ERP access. Optional audit=1 returns excluded/duplicate source text and reasons to the same authenticated role. Count reconciliation covers collected archive messages only, not source Kakao completeness.

actions.source: validated ERP-only CountryOrderMatrix through generatePedidosFromMatrix; subweek chooses and loads only; explicit preview button opens same-origin wide preview with a fullscreen fallback and identical state; download ETA label uses YYYY-MM-DD and retains workbook cell types and formulas; compares actual exported item/unit totals and ETA against five local-account snapshots per country/year/exact subweek/output filename; confirms OS save via browser writable close or Electron exact blob done, cancellation and failure do not record; explicit XLSX file import supports the unverified/legacy path; existing upload generatePedidos path remains intact; browser file only

criteriaLedger.compactPresentation: countryOrderPresentation generates a compact customer matrix as the first sheet, retaining all legacy country worksheets and formulas. Display-only common prefixes are shortened; original product name, ProdKey and current/stored quantity diagnostics remain accessible via an explicit row detail button.
criteriaLedger.chinaFarmSplit: Browser-only recipient names default Melody/CLOUD; splitting is off by default, preserving the existing Melody filename, searchable from existing master GET or directly editable. No FarmKey is invented and no ShipmentFarm write occurs. ProdKey-selected products including all customers go to farm1, all remaining products go to farm2; same/blank names and stale product selections block generation. Scope changes clear selection. prepareCountryOrderPedidos validates the complete matrix before any partition.
criteriaLedger.eta: Download opens ETA calendar plus manual YYYY-MM-DD input. Country-specific default is stored only in this browser localStorage. First default is PeriodDay cycle start+7 days; saved date follows actual cycle-start difference, same-major subweek unchanged, no guessed ISO calendar. Excel A1 appends Semana <week>차 ETA (year,month,day EnglishWeekday); title row minimum60pt prevents clipping. Other cells/formulas/source workbook preserved.
criteriaLedger.noOmission: No partial blocked-product export. Excluded rows are rejected by adapter. Hidden active orders block download until administrator resolves native linkage; no ERP repair is performed.
criteriaLedger.viewport: 1920x1080 CSS pixels at 100%; page vertical scroll and matrix horizontal scroll; right Kakao source list has a bounded vertical scroll to match the requested feed
criteriaLedger.importSourceFeed: The default right source list preserves timestamp, multiline text and style, without reference labels. Matching an aggregate reveals any otherwise filtered contributors, highlights exact source-key matches in the chronological list, and scrolls to the first match. It preserves source filters for clearing the match. Matching an original shows only the linked total rows and their separate source quantity. Both sides share the selected source reference; cancellation source rows are read-only and cannot enter totals.
criteriaLedger.importFarmLedger: Default summary uses original cycle/group, cultivar, quantity and customer remarks columns. There is no extra detail panel. References and source quantities appear only after matching. Copy covers the whole selected cycle/product group in the original format, independently of matching.
criteriaLedger.importSourceIncluded: The metadata check means at least one exact row from this message is in the valid farm totals for the current year/cycle and product-group scope. Matching focus and right-side filters do not recalculate it. Unchecked items, cancellations and unapproved review items contribute no source keys. An invalid blocking item hides totals and all checks.
criteriaLedger.calendar: PeriodDay is authoritative; Asia/Seoul today main cycle plus next five, exactly six unique contiguous Thursday rows; no ISO week or 52-week fallback
criteriaLedger.request: country plus explicit year and majorWeek; year/majorWeek omitted together means current cycle; partial or outside-six scope rejected
criteriaLedger.sqlScope: v.OrderYear=@orderYear AND v.OrderWeek LIKE @majorWeek + '-%' and exact server country mapping
criteriaLedger.quantityReview: Existing stem and bunch lines show original ERP quantity and accept file-only overrides, including zero. Every edit recalculates totals and invalidates old downloads. Missing required quantities keep their existing review path.
criteriaLedger.selection: Country buttons unlock explicit year/majorWeek. list=subweeks fetches available weeks only. Selecting the full orderWeek fetches its rows and exposes each valid workbook download.
criteriaLedger.subweeks: derive actual full OrderWeek values only; numeric subweek then exact suffix ordering; never invent 01 or 02
criteriaLedger.customerCode: Customer.OrderCode by CustKey. Blank CL is normal and emits no missing-code warning: display customer name, never invent a code, preserve every CustKey/product quantity. Shared collision-safe labels in matrix/export disambiguate duplicate names and real-code collisions by display-only CustKey suffix.
criteriaLedger.customerIdentity: ERP uses CustKey; duplicate OrderCode remains separate and gets display-only CustKey suffix
criteriaLedger.uploadCustomerColumns: preserve legacy Netherlands precedence: explicit <code> Total is the sole source when present; do not add same-code detail columns again; without Total, same-code detail columns are summed; prefix recognition must not change this
criteriaLedger.productIdentity: ERP uses ProdKey; uploaded duplicate product-name rows are summed per customer code with row-number warning instead of last-row overwrite
criteriaLedger.netherlandsErpQuantity: stored ViewOrder.SteamQuantity only for every OutUnit; never infer from OutQuantity, BunchQuantity, SteamOf1Bunch or product name
criteriaLedger.productUnitDisplay: Current Product.OutUnit, SteamOf1Bunch, BunchOf1Box and SteamOf1Box are display-only metadata, not historical quantity conversion authority. Show current basis separately from saved order quantities and export unit; zero or missing factors are not replaced with one.
criteriaLedger.zeroQuantityDisplay: Hide numeric zero quantity cells in matrix and preview; Excel quantity cells use [=0] empty display with General for nonzero values while keeping stored values and formulas. Diagnostic zero values, product identities and rows remain visible.
criteriaLedger.netherlandsUploadQuantity: uploaded numeric value is already stems and is preserved exactly; no tulip, hyacinth, skimmia, eucalyptus or other name multiplier
criteriaLedger.missingNetherlandsStems: positive order evidence with SteamQuantity<=0 is retained and blocks export as STEM_QUANTITY_UNAVAILABLE
criteriaLedger.codeRecognition: trimmed case-insensitive ^[A-Z]*CL[A-Z0-9_-]*$ recognizes CL, BCL, HCL, KCL, MCL, YCL and suffix variants; unknown non-empty codes retained with warning
criteriaLedger.staleRequests: AbortController plus request generation and exact response scopeKey; stale/cancelled/partial responses cannot mutate current state or enable download
criteriaLedger.converterBoundary: CountryOrderMatrix and generatePedidosFromMatrix are ERP-only additions; do not rewrite generatePedidos(workbook, ...) or unrelated country upload parsers
criteriaLedger.sideEffects: authenticated GET SELECT plus browser-local parse/export only; no ERP or web-table write. Exception (2026-11-04): when a blocked product had a web-entered quantity, PedidosTool asks "품목관리에 변경하시겠습니까?" and, only on explicit confirm, POSTs Product conversion factors (SteamOf1Bunch/BunchOf1Box/SteamOf1Box) to the existing audited /api/master/products-bulk under the product-save-compat contract; country-orders itself stays GET-only and never touches order quantities
criteriaLedger.exportProductOrder: Each generated workbook sorts product names A-Z case-insensitively before writing rows/formulas, for ERP and uploaded input. Country/category/unit file splits remain unchanged. Ecuador retains adjacent half-box pairing after name sorting.
criteriaLedger.importKakaoText: docs/plans/import-kakao-filter-2026-11-18.md; raw-first selection shared by API/fixtures/browser; review items excluded until explicit check, no guessed photo quantities; customer aliases require unambiguous evidence.
